title: Turkey steak pepperonata
summary: Turkey steak pepperonata is a italian dinner built around turkey breast steaks and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat turkey breast steaks dry and season it. Prep red peppers and yellow peppers for Turkey steak pepperonata so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook turkey breast steaks on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook red peppers and yellow peppers in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Turkey steak pepperonata before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice turkey breast steaks and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
